# Jiten Topiwala
> Robotics Engineer & Innovator — Robotics Engineer with a Mechanical Engineering degree, combining hardware expertise with software intelligence to create machines that matter.

I'm a Robotics Engineer currently serving as Founding Robotics Engineer at Agmove Robotics, where I lead autonomous navigation, embedded systems, and control software for sub-20HP agricultural rovers. My journey blends mechanical design, robotics software (ROS2, Nav2, perception), and embedded firmware — with a portfolio spanning award-winning competition robots, industrial inspection systems, agricultural automation, surveillance robots (with a patent in process), and published research in IEEE and IJIRT. I enjoy bridging the gap between research and real-world deployable systems.

## Skills
- **Robotics & Autonomy:** ROS, ROS2 (Humble / Jazzy), Nav2, NVIDIA Isaac ROS, FAST-LIO2, VSLAM, SLAM, Motion Planning, Path Planning, Sensor Fusion, Kinematics & Dynamics, Inverse Kinematics, PID Control, Reinforcement Learning, micro-ROS, MoveIt
- **Simulation & Modelling:** MATLAB, Simulink, Simscape, Gazebo, Gazebo 11, Ignition Gazebo, RViz, Foxglove, MuJoCo, CFD, MotionGen, FEA, Abaqus
- **Mechanical Design:** SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, GD&T, DFMA, DFM, Tolerance Analysis, PLM, Sheet Metal, 3D Printing, Ultimaker Cura, CNC Machining, Moulding, FRP
- **Embedded & Electronics:** STM32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Cube Orange Plus, PX4, ArduPilot, MAVROS, ArduSub, QGroundControl, BlueOS, CAN, RS485, I2C, Motor Drivers (Cytron, BLDC ESCs), PCB Design, EasyEDA, ATtiny85, ESP32 / ESP32-CAM, Sensor Integration
- **Perception & Computer Vision:** OpenCV, ArUco Markers, Image Processing, Pose Estimation, Livox Mid-360, LIDAR, Cameras, GNSS RTK, IMU
- **Compute & Platforms:** NVIDIA Jetson, Linux, Docker, Git, GitHub
- **Programming:** Python, C, C++, MATLAB Scripting, Bash
- **Web & Cloud:** MQTT (Mosquitto), Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS), Backend / Fleet Management, Robot Cockpit / Mission Planner UI

## Featured Projects
- **Manpackable Transformable Surveillance Robot** (Wheel-Track Transformable Surveillance Robot — single-actuator Modified Watt II six-bar linkage): A compact, rugged, man-packable surveillance robot that transforms between wheel mode and track-belt mode using a single-actuator Modified Watt II six-bar linkage. Designed for search-and-rescue, reconnaissance, and disaster-response operations in confined or hazardous environments.
- **Sub-20HP Autonomous Agricultural Rover** (Founding-engineer-led farm automation platform): Sub-20HP agricultural rover automating labour-intensive farming tasks. End-to-end ownership: mechanical design, ROS2 navigation stack (Nav2 + FAST-LIO2 + Isaac ROS VSLAM), STM32 firmware over CAN/RS485, Jetson-based perception, Docker-based simulation, web-based fleet management. — https://agmove.in/
- **LiftTerra** (Revolutionising Construction & Maintenance): Robotic platform designed to automate heavy lifting and material transport on construction sites — reducing physical strain on workers and increasing efficiency. — https://jiten-topiwala.github.io/LiftTerra/
- **Robocon 2024 — Harvest Day** (Two collaborative robots for ball shooting and seedling placement): Designed two collaborative robots for the 'Harvest Day' theme — a semi-autonomous robot for picking/shooting coloured balls and placing seedling-like poles, and a fully autonomous robot for ball detection and basket placement.
- **Robocon 2023 — Ring Toss** (Two robots for ring shooting on poles using dual-roller mechanism): Built two robots for the ring-toss-on-pole game. Finalised a dual-roller ring-shooting mechanism after iterative prototyping; one robot used mecanum wheels, the other omni wheels. Automated the shooting task in MATLAB using simulation-derived datasets.
- **e-Yantra Robotics — Hologlyph Bots** (Custom omni-wheel robots with overhead-camera vision feedback): Designed and programmed three custom omni-wheel robots (continuous servo-driven, holonomic) tracked in real time by an overhead camera using ArUco markers. Used ROS2 + micro-ROS for multi-robot coordination and Gazebo 11 for simulation; visualised in RViz and Foxglove. — https://github.com/vaishnavimulik25/eyrc23_hb_1520
- **Pipe Inspection Robot (400–900 mm)** (Variable-diameter inspection robot — IIT Roorkee research): Versatile robotic system for navigation and inspection of pipelines with varying characteristics, diameters (400–900 mm), and fluid dynamics. Scissor-mechanism-based geometry adjustment with thruster-based propulsion.
- **Miniature Pipe Inspection Robot (35–95 mm)** (Gear-based transformable miniature inspector — ATtiny85 control): Miniature variant of the pipe-inspection robot for 35–95 mm pipes using a gear-based transformation mechanism, with a custom ATtiny85-based feedback controller and PCB schematic designed in EasyEDA, forwarded for validation and manufacturing.
- **Agricultural Gantry System** (Rope-driven farm-coverage robot): Gantry-style farming robot moving on a rope along one axis (rope tensioned by a cable winch) and on two base drives along the perpendicular axis. Carries an arm, tank, and sensors for various farm operations; base-drive endpoints double as water refill / charging / storage stations. — https://ijirt.org/publishedpaper/IJIRT167610_PAPER.pdf
- **Advanced Drone Navigation & Landing — Parrot MiniDrone** (Multi-algorithm integration for autonomous landing): Multi-algorithm-integrated navigation and precision-landing approach for the Parrot MiniDrone platform. Published in IEEE Xplore and presented at the 2024 IEEE Pune Section International Conference (PuneCon). — https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10895147
- **Biped — Dynamic Walking Robot** (Stable bipedal walker with inverse kinematics + RL gait optimisation): Research / personal-project bipedal robot focused on stable dynamic walking. Lightweight mechanical structure, real-time control, inverse kinematics, embedded feedback, and gait optimisation via MATLAB simulations and reinforcement learning.
- **Vertical Indexing Conveyor** (Chain-sprocket-driven industrial system): Robust vertical conveyor for space-efficient buffering and indexing in automated assembly lines. Precision chain-sprocket drive with synchronised motion control. — https://www.indiamart.com/vrushabhnathindustries/?pid=5741294388&c_id=841&mid=8219&pn=Roller%20Type%20Conveyor&cui=1
- **Mobile Manipulator Motion Planning** (MORPH-I pick & place · freelance (obotx, Poland)): End-to-end autonomous pick & place for the MORPH-I mobile manipulator using OMPL motion planning in MuJoCo. Base navigation, arm grasp, and gripper open/close are each solved by OMPL with their own collision-aware state space — planned, not scripted. — https://github.com/obotx/motion-planning

## Experience
- **Founding Robotics Engineer** @ Agmove Robotics: Spearheading the development of autonomous navigation and control systems for sub-20HP agricultural rovers to automate labor-intensive farming tasks.
- **Mechanical Design Intern** @ Peppermint Robotics: Worked across flagship and next-gen platforms — docking station, advance float-kit, SD45 / SD20 / Gen 3 robots, and a clean-room-certified variant — leading mechanical design with quantified production and reliability gains.
- **Senior Engineer** @ Robot Study Circle (RSC), COEP: Four-year journey at COEP's robotics club — from hands-on builder to senior engineer leading mechanical design, simulation, and team management across national-level competitions.
- **Research Intern — Robotics & Controls Lab** @ IIT Roorkee: Developed pipe-inspection robots — a versatile system for 400–900 mm pipes (scissor mechanism) and a miniature variant for 35–95 mm pipes (gear-based transformation, ATtiny85 controller).
- **Research & Development Intern** @ Agmove Robotics: Designed and developed a conceptual product through to a manufacturing-feasible prototype, coordinating vendors, simplifying processes, and running on-field testing.

## Services
- **Legged & Physical-AI Robotics:** Gait and locomotion control, RL policies, and sim-to-real for quadrupeds and humanoids — in MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or on your hardware.
- **ROS 2 Simulation & Navigation:** Gazebo / Isaac Sim worlds, Nav2 stacks, SLAM, and the sim-to-real pipeline that gets your robot navigating reliably — validated before hardware.
- **Full-Stack Robot Development:** Mechanical design + embedded (STM32 / Jetson) + control, taken from an idea or a stalled prototype to a tested, documented, deployed system.
- **Robotics R&D & Technical Consulting:** Architecture reviews, technology selection, proof-of-concept builds, and IEEE-standard documentation — backed by published research.
